question_or_fact: What happened to Moss in the cold-open fire?
audience_knows_before: The protagonist returns to a burning shared home and directs every action towards Moss before the scene cuts.
audience_expects_before: Moss may still be in the room and reachable.
character_knowledge_before: The protagonist knows Moss was left sitting on the rug but has not yet seen the room.
audience_knows_after: The sitting place is empty, the surrounding search fails and Moss is gone from observable R4.
audience_expects_after: The protagonist will seek a reality in which Moss is certainly alive, but the exact R4 fate may remain unseen.
emotional_orientation_after: Loss, uncertainty and sympathy without a false property dilemma.
notes: The film supplies absence rather than a corpse, collar object or unshown claim of survival.

question_or_fact: Where does the first portal crossing lead?
audience_knows_before: The active frame sits beneath a recognisable R0 ravine.
audience_expects_before: It may lead to the Nether, another location or another state of the same world.
character_knowledge_before: The protagonist has no tested model and expects ordinary portal logic to be relevant.
audience_knows_after: Matching granite and coordinates exist beneath incompatible natural history in R1.
audience_expects_after: Re-entry appears likely to return to R0 until the next transition disproves it.
notes: Geography establishes place before the story names realities.

question_or_fact: Are the destinations different realities rather than changing times or resets?
audience_knows_before: R1 and R2 share geography but have incompatible water and surface states.
audience_expects_before: The portal may be cycling one mutable world.
character_knowledge_before: The protagonist suspects an ordered chain but lacks a persistent test.
audience_knows_after: A cobblestone mark placed beside one mouth is absent beside the next while coordinates and frame geometry persist.
audience_expects_after: The audience expects stable echoes with local block histories.
notes: The Atlas later labels a model already supported by action.

question_or_fact: Why can the protagonist not simply go back or keep crossing?
audience_knows_before: The first return attempt advances and successive mouths follow the same pattern.
audience_expects_before: A later mouth might eventually cycle back to R0.
character_knowledge_before: The protagonist knows only that each observed crossing has moved forwards.
audience_knows_after: The Atlas records a forward-only unanchored chain, and the R4 mouth closes before another crossing is possible.
audience_expects_after: A deliberately keyed full frame becomes the only proposed route to the first threshold.
emotional_orientation_after: Knowledge provides hope while stranding becomes real.
notes: The rule is fictional canon and remains subject to human approval.

audience_knows_before: The protagonist carries a clean journal with a distinctive ravine symbol and repaired corner.
audience_expects_before: Any portal explanation may come from an unknown prior traveller.
character_knowledge_before: He knows his own notation and has not seen another person.
audience_knows_after: The Archive book is an older counterpart of his journal, and the final R0 image repeats its clean beginning.
audience_expects_after: Another echo of the protagonist is the strongest inference, but its exact experimental history remains open.
emotional_orientation_after: Personal uncanniness rather than external lore exposition.
notes: No counterpart appears or speaks; only the document and final prop support the inference.

audience_knows_before: The house has a stone-surrounded open hearth and Moss routinely sits on a wool rug beside it.
audience_expects_before: The stone may appear to make the fireplace safe.
character_knowledge_before: The protagonist believes the permanent flame is contained.
audience_knows_after: Fire spreads from the open hearth to wool within range, then from the rug into the timber room while he is away.
audience_expects_after: The audience can trace the cold-open burn fan without an echo force or random explosion.
emotional_orientation_after: Tragic recognition of an affectionate practical mistake.
notes: Exact spread distance and simulation behaviour require target-version testing.

question_or_fact: How can a complete crying-obsidian frame behave differently?
audience_knows_before: The observed frame already connects realities and ignores ordinary reverse travel.
character_knowledge_before: The protagonist has verified only the unanchored next-echo rule.
audience_knows_after: The Atlas proposes that a full frame keyed by direct respawn-anchor discharge reaches the traveller's first threshold.
audience_expects_after: The final build will test the method under lethal uncertainty.
notes: The story labels this rule as invented rather than vanilla Minecraft.

question_or_fact: Why is the protagonist away when the rug catches fire?
audience_knows_before: He has been collecting portal materials gradually while living with Moss.
audience_expects_before: A final journey may complete the Atlas method.
character_knowledge_before: He believes Moss is safer sitting at home than travelling through the hazardous supply route.
audience_knows_after: The final run supplies the crying obsidian and glowstone dropped in the cold open and leaves Moss beside the vulnerable rug.
audience_expects_after: Those same materials can now drive an immediate grief response.
emotional_orientation_after: Foreboding grounded in a responsible-looking choice.
notes: The route and loaded-area behaviour remain production questions.

question_or_fact: What causes the final explosion and death?
audience_knows_before: The Atlas shows a charged anchor, direct-hand keying and a torn blast-distance page.
audience_expects_before: The protagonist may construct enough protection to survive and cross.
character_knowledge_before: He knows the activation is dangerous but lacks the final safety measurement.
audience_knows_after: His direct discharge produces the explosion, kills him and wakes the fictional portal field after his death.
audience_expects_after: The audience expects the active frame to reveal a destination without carrying him through.
emotional_orientation_after: Shock followed by tragic mechanical satisfaction.
notes: Candidate anchor behaviour requires verification; crying-frame activation remains explicit invention.

question_or_fact: Who made the initial portal, and where does the final frame lead?
audience_knows_before: The R0 mouth has no local builder and the opening surface scene appears to precede all portal events.
audience_expects_before: The protagonist may build a similar gate without proving it is the same connection.
character_knowledge_before: He believes the full frame will seek his first threshold but cannot observe its result before death.
audience_knows_after: The protagonist materially builds the R4 frame, and the camera emerges into the exact R0 arrival above its projected receiving mouth.
audience_expects_after: The earlier pair will descend, enter and begin the same one-way journey.
emotional_orientation_after: Mystery resolution, tenderness and loop recognition.
notes: Nobody built the frame locally in R0; its constructed source is the connected R4 frame.
